proposal.summary: VERDICT: MISSION_AUTONOMY_NOT_CONFIRMED. The Runtime will NOT autonomously execute IMPLEMENT_DEVELOPER_ENGINE_V1 to completion. The ODG pipeline (runtime/bin/odg-run.js) is single-pass: it runs a fixed stage list once and exits at 'PIPELINE SUCCESS' with no loop over the 5 actions or 9 missing capabilities; mission-loader.js always re-selects brainLines[0] as nextObjective, so there is no progression state. The two implementation-critical actions are no-ops: patch-executor.js only handles PROCESS_TODOS/PROCESS_FIXMES/ANALYZE_DEPENDENCIES (writing report .txt files) while OPTIMIZE_DEPENDENCIES and IMPLEMENT_MISSING_CAPABILITIES fall through to default SKIPPED. The only continuously-running component is fleet-bridge.js (observed live as pid 422835 in watch mode), but it is passive and request-driven: it drains an externally-populated request mailbox, invokes 'claude -p --permission-mode manual' (agent cannot apply edits), and writes only a {mission,summary,actions} PROPOSAL envelope. fleet-collector.js validates/analyzes/governance-gates that proposal and stops at VALIDATED — no component ever applies proposed actions to the codebase, and nothing auto-dispatches follow-on missions. Left unattended, the Bridge stays alive and safely answers any request that appears, but once the mailbox drains it sits idle and the mission does not advance. It is therefore safe-to-run but will not self-complete.
actions: Analyzed runtime execution state: odg-run.js is a one-shot spawnSync stage loop that exits at PIPELINE SUCCESS — no iteration until mission completion
Confirmed no progression state: mission-loader.js sets nextObjective=brainLines[0] every run; execution-planner.js writes static step-name strings without executing them
Identified blocking mechanism #1: patch-executor.js switch defaults IMPLEMENT_MISSING_CAPABILITIES and OPTIMIZE_DEPENDENCIES to SKIPPED (unimplemented)
Identified blocking mechanism #2: fleet-bridge.json invokes claude with --permission-mode manual, so the agent produces proposals only and cannot autonomously edit files
Identified blocking mechanism #3: fleet-bridge is request-driven and requires fleet-dispatcher to enqueue work; no scheduler/cron re-dispatches follow-on missions
Traced exchange terminus: fleet-collector.js advances requests only to VALIDATED; no stage consumes proposal.actions to mutate the repository
Confirmed live component: fleet-bridge.js running as pid 422835 in watch mode (responsive but idle without incoming requests)
FINAL VERDICT: MISSION_AUTONOMY_NOT_CONFIRMED — Runtime is safe to leave running but lacks an autonomous drive/apply loop to reach mission completion without human commands
